title: Trend ends
description: Three upswings from 25,792 to the 27,687 high (18 Mar 00:00); the second break of structure (27,163 on 17 Mar 21:00) confirms the uptrend. An hour after the high, the close of 27,394 breaks the last pullback low (a bearish market structure break), but the trend only ends when a downswing breaks structure: 27,289 on 18 Mar 08:00.
